snippet.title: Corner Kitchen Fast Food Simulator | Official PlayStation 5 (PS5) Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
🍔Available now on PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10017600

Run your own fast food restaurant in Corner Kitchen Fast Food Simulator. Prepare meals, serve customers, hire staff, and expand your business step by step. Design and customize your restaurant, manage reputation, and become the king of fast food.

#CornerKitchen #FastFoodSimulator #SimulationGame #TycoonGame #IndieGame #PlayStation5 #XboxSeriesX
